justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Positive effects for CP and adult neurological conditions; comparative superiority vs dose-matched alternatives not demonstrated.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: 8-day basic course; significant cost (~$2,000+); advanced courses add further investment.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable in pediatric and adult neurological rehabilitation; broadly used in both peds and neuro settings.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: Billed under therapeutic activities and neuro re-education codes; no NDT-specific code; standard commercial and Medicare coverage.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Frequently listed as required or preferred in pediatric and neuro PT/OT postings; strong institutional adoption.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Hands-on facilitation approach well-tolerated; neuro population engagement is complex.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Pediatric and stroke families occasionally pay cash for NDT-trained therapists, but most care is insurance-based.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Some brand recognition among parents of CP kids, but limited pricing power overall.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Recognizable legacy brand in peds/neuro; differentiates within those niches.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Hands-on, clinician-dependent model; doesn't scale across staff easily.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Modest direct recognition in pediatric communities; otherwise low.
justifications.business.efficiency: Long, expensive multi-week course series — poor cost/time profile.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Increasingly viewed as dated; not weighted heavily in modern faculty hiring.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Limited contemporary publication output associated with the credential.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Still referenced in peds/neuro curricula, useful for historical and handling-skill content.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Evidence base is weak — systematic reviews show NDT is no better than alternatives.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Rarely required; programs prefer NCS or PCS.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Expensive and time-intensive relative to the academic recognition gained.
